# Load the cctyper output data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

results <- read_tsv("Data/all_cas_operons.tab") %>% filter(Contig != "Contig")

dim(results)

#write(results$Contig, "Data/contigs_with_crispr.txt")
# Send that to chtc, and make the output file.

results %>% group_by(Prediction) %>% tally() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y=n, x=Prediction)) +
  geom_col()+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(y = "Count")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90))

taxonomy <- read_tsv("Data/all_genomes_noDuplicates.tsv")

used_in_htcondor <- taxonomy %>% filter(gtdb_species_representative == TRUE)

write.table(x= used_in_htcondor, file="Output/accessions_used_for_cctyper.txt", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE)


nrow(used_in_htcondor)

contigs_with_crispr <- read.table("Data/contigs_with_crispr_clean.txt", sep="\t", header=FALSE)

colnames(results)

colnames(contigs_with_crispr) <- colnames(results)

contigs_with_crispr <- contigs_with_crispr %>% separate(Contig, into = c("Folder","Contig"), sep="/")

contigs_with_crispr$Contig <- str_replace(contigs_with_crispr$Contig, "cas_operons.tab:","")

contigs_with_crispr$Folder <- str_replace(contigs_with_crispr$Folder, "my_output_","")

contigs_with_crispr$accession <- contigs_with_crispr$Folder

# Remove everything after the 2nd underscore, including it
contigs_with_crispr$accession  <- str_replace(contigs_with_crispr$accession, "^([^_]+_[^_]+)_.*","\\1")

contigs_with_crispr <- left_join(contigs_with_crispr, taxonomy)

contigs_with_crispr <- contigs_with_crispr %>% separate(gtdb_taxonomy, sep="; ", into=c("Domain","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species"))


contigs_with_crispr %>% distinct() %>% nrow()

unique(contigs_with_crispr$accession) %>% length()

# Taxonomic distribution of the MAGs:

write.table(x= contigs_with_crispr, file="Output/contigs_with_crispr.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE)

# Comparison of how many genomes were queried vs. how many had positive results.

nrow(used_in_htcondor)
nrow(contigs_with_crispr)

```


# Summarize family level all the data.
```{R}

genomes_with_crispr_count <- contigs_with_crispr %>% mutate(PCOF= paste(Phylum, Class, Order, Family)) %>% select(accession, Prediction, PCOF) %>% distinct() %>% group_by(Prediction, PCOF) %>% tally()

colnames(genomes_with_crispr_count)[3] <- "genomes_with_crispr"



genomes_all_count <- taxonomy %>% filter(gtdb_species_representative == TRUE) %>%
  separate(gtdb_taxonomy, sep="; ", into=c("Domain","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species")) %>%
  mutate(PCOF= paste(Phylum, Class, Order, Family)) %>% 
  select(accession,PCOF) %>%
  group_by(PCOF) %>% tally()

colnames(genomes_all_count)[2] <- "total_genomes"


genomes_count <- full_join(genomes_all_count, genomes_with_crispr_count)

genomes_count <- genomes_count %>% mutate(percentage = genomes_with_crispr/total_genomes)

ggplot(genomes_count %>% filter(Prediction != "NA"), aes(x=Prediction, y=PCOF, col = percentage, fill=percentage))+
  geom_tile()+
  scale_color_distiller(palette = "Spectral")+
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))+
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F5F2F2", color = "black")
  )


#ggsave("figures/greA/family_level_summary.pdf", width = 11, height = 8)
```

# Genus only plot
```{r}

genus_only <- c("g__Ketogulonicigenium",
                "g__Paenibacillus",
                "g__GPS1B09",
                "g__Anaerovibrio",
                "g__Faecalibacterium",
                "g__Agathobacter",
                "g__Methylomonas",
                "g__Methylobacterium",
                "g__Muiribacterium","g__Muriicola","g__Defluviilinea","g__Flavonifractor","g__Herbinix","g__Pseudomonas")

# Subset all the genus in the excel sheet:genus_only

contigs_with_crispr_genus <- contigs_with_crispr %>% filter(Genus %in% genus_only)

length(unique(contigs_with_crispr_genus$accession))


taxonomy %>% filter(gtdb_species_representative == TRUE) %>% filter(
)


# Summarize the data at the genus level.
genomes_with_crispr_count_genus <- contigs_with_crispr %>% mutate(PG = paste(Phylum, Genus)) %>% filter(Genus %in% genus_only) %>%
  select(accession, Prediction, PG) %>% distinct() %>% group_by(Prediction, PG) %>% tally()

colnames(genomes_with_crispr_count_genus)[3] <- "genomes_with_crispr"


genomes_all_count_genus <- taxonomy %>% filter(gtdb_species_representative == TRUE) %>%
  separate(gtdb_taxonomy, sep="; ", into=c("Domain","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species")) %>%
  mutate(PG = paste(Phylum, Genus)) %>% 
  filter(Genus %in% genus_only) %>%
  select(accession,PG) %>%
  group_by(PG) %>% tally()

colnames(genomes_all_count_genus)[2] <- "total_genomes"


genomes_count_genus <- full_join(genomes_all_count_genus, genomes_with_crispr_count_genus)

genomes_count_genus <- genomes_count_genus %>% mutate(percentage = genomes_with_crispr/total_genomes)

write.table(genomes_count_genus, file = "Output/genus_count_table.tsv",sep="\t", row.names = FALSE)

heatmap_genus <- ggplot(genomes_count_genus %>% filter(Prediction != "NA"), aes(x=Prediction, y=PG, col = percentage, fill=percentage))+
  geom_tile()+
  scale_color_distiller(name = "Fraction", palette = "Spectral")+
  scale_fill_distiller(name = "Fraction", palette = "Spectral")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))+
  theme(
    text = element_text(color="black"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F5F2F2", color = "black"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

heatmap_genus

library(forcats)

bar_genus <- ggplot(
  genomes_count_genus %>% 
    filter(!is.na(Prediction)) %>% 
    select(PG, genomes_with_crispr, total_genomes) %>% 
    gather("type", "count", genomes_with_crispr, total_genomes) %>% 
    group_by(PG, type) %>%
    summarize(sum_count = sum(count), .groups = "drop"),
  
  aes(x = sum_count, y = PG, fill = fct_rev(type))) + 
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sum_count),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    hjust = -0.2,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("genomes_with_crispr"="#93193a",
                              "total_genomes"="#2f3794")) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(color="black"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    #legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  xlab("Genome count")

bar_genus

library(ggpubr)

ggarrange(heatmap_genus, bar_genus, align = "h")
bar_genus_minimal <- bar_genus + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank(), legend.position="none")

ggarrange(heatmap_genus, bar_genus_minimal, align = "h", widths = c(1,0.5))

ggsave(filename = "Output/heatmap_barplot_genus_level_summary.pdf", 
       width = 8.5, 
       height = 4)

```
